text:
noah: quick report - the new edge starter example is giving downstream ESM consumers collapsed overloads: generics become `any`. CJS consumers fine.

rhea: can you paste a minimal repro?

noah: sure: 
```ts
// src/api.ts
export function pick(x: string): string;
export function pick<T>(x: T): T;
export function pick(x: any) { return x }
```
Built files: dist/esm/index.mjs, dist/cjs/index.cjs, and a single dist/index.d.ts. When a Next/nodenext project imports the ESM path, the editor shows `pick` as `(x: any) => any`. No build-time TS errors.

sam: likely resolver + declarations mismatch. ESM import path leads TS to look for `index.mjs.d.ts` (or follow `exports`), and if it doesn't find a matching d.ts it falls back to `any`. What does package.json exports look like?

noah: exports: { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, types: "dist/index.d.ts"

rhea: classic. TS resolution for conditional exports is quirky. Options: 1) produce `dist/esm/index.mjs.d.ts` alongside ESM file, 2) add `typesVersions` so TS maps imports to dist/types, or 3) point `types` to a neutral entry under dist that both import/require paths resolve to.

sam: also implementation detail: using `any` in the impl can cause declaration emit to widen generics. Prefer impl like `function pick<T>(x: T): T { return x as T }` so generated d.ts keeps overloads/generics.

noah: good point - changing impl helped locally but CI still showed the ESM consumer problem because lookup failed.

rhea: for starter DX we usually do a tiny postbuild: emit declarations to dist/types/index.d.ts, then copy that file to dist/esm/index.mjs.d.ts and dist/cjs/index.cjs.d.ts. Update package.json `types` to dist/types/index.d.ts and add a `typesVersions` mapping: { "*": { "*": ["dist/types/*"] } } to be extra-safe.

sam: +1. also add a tsd test in CI that imports the built ESM entry and asserts the generic shape. Catches regressions from bundler changes (tsup/esbuild) or updates to tsconfig.

noah: any gotchas with nodenext vs bundler resolution?

rhea: yeah: `moduleResolution: bundler` vs `node` behave differently in editor. Recommend contributors set `moduleResolution: bundler` locally for parity with Vite/Next, but CI should validate with `node` resolution against emitted artifacts. Document this in starter README.

sam: small extra: some bundlers rewrite helpers or fold type-only exports which can inadvertently remove generic re-exports. If public API re-exports types across packages, ensure `preserveValueImports` or avoid mixed type/value re-exports that confuse emit.

dev-docs-bot: created issue #537 "starter: ESM declaration resolution causes collapsed overloads for ESM consumers" and branch starter/fix-537.

noah: i'll open a PR with postbuild copy + tsd CI job + README blurb. will include a tiny reproduce repo link and note to avoid impl `any` on public functions. thanks for the quick triage. :slightly_smiling_face:
